purpose: Registered before acquiring the Caltech November raw ACN extract. This temporal replication reuses the frozen V3 controller and reports all outcomes without using November to select, tune, or replace any method.

acn_data_protocol.controller_information: At plug-in use the earliest complete declared kWhRequested and requestedDeparture plus observable connection state. Actual disconnectTime is a hidden environment event.
acn_data_protocol.unclaimed_session_policy: Exclude sessions without a complete initial commitment from primary analysis.
acn_data_protocol.target_interpretation: Service ratio is delivered energy divided by user-declared requested energy.

charging_data.station_assignment: deterministic hash of session ID across synthetic stations
charging_data.note: Real ACN sessions are mapped to synthetic feeder stations.

solar_data.note: Solar-resource proxy, not measured rooftop PV.

feeder_sensitivity.note: Synthetic shared-import scarcity, not Caltech's measured feeder limit.

v3.selection_status: pre-acquisition temporal replication; V3 was selected on Caltech September before this November extract was acquired. November cannot change the selected policy, CQR features, CQR hyperparameters, V1 guard, tail fraction, evaluation metric, or physical sensitivity assumptions.
v3.selection_rule: Copied unchanged from the Caltech September development decision: choose the causal deployable policy with the largest raw all-session P10 service ratio; require zero unsafe steps, then use lower expected shortfall as the tie-break.

statistical_protocol.unit_of_inference: matched calendar day; never individual EV session
statistical_protocol.inference: paired calendar-day bootstrap interval plus a one-sided paired sign-flip test for the predeclared primary endpoint (exact through 16 eligible day blocks; otherwise seeded 100,000-draw Monte Carlo); secondary/exploratory family receives Holm adjustment when tested together
statistical_protocol.minimum_support: daily P10 requires at least 10 sessions; daily early-unplug P10 requires at least 10 early-unplug sessions; a reported test requires at least 5 eligible days
statistical_protocol.forbidden_after_acquisition: Do not alter controller selection, data windows, metrics, CQR features/hyperparameters, guard settings, tail fraction, station mapping, PV proxy, feeder limit, or statistical primary endpoint after the raw test file is acquired.
